assumptions.structure: SELL CE 3 strikes OTM, SELL PE 3 strikes OTM, BUY CE 8 strikes OTM, BUY PE 8 strikes OTM

margin.note: SPAN + exposure estimate, same model as the live builder

quality.note: Flags mark days worth opening, not days that are wrong. A stale or gapped day means the price path under it was thin, so that day's exit was decided against a quote that may not have been live.
